clear_default_bindings.description: If true, clears all default keybindings at the start of the config file.

daemonize.description: If true, keynav will background itself after parsing the config and setting up bindings.

macro_record_key.description: The key used to start/stop recording macros.

macro_file_path.description: The file path where recorded macros are stored.

macro_playback_key.description: The key binding used to play back recorded macros. 'shift+at' corresponds to Shift+2.

start_keybinding.description: The global keybinding to activate keynav navigation mode.

mouse_click_key.description: The key binding to warp mouse to center of current cell and perform a left click.

enter_click_key.description: Alternative key binding to warp mouse and click (Enter key).

custom_command_binding.description: A user-defined key binding for a custom shell command (e.g., paste).

custom_command_action.description: The keynav command action associated with the custom_command_binding.
